{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Stratford Square Mall is a shopping mall in Bloomingdale, Illinois.","title":"Stratford Square Mall"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The 1300000 sqft mall has four anchors: Carson's, Kohl's, Sears, and Burlington Coat Factory with two vacant anchors last occupied by JCPenney and Macy's.","title":"Stratford Square Mall"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Towne West Square is an enclosed shopping mall located in Wichita, Kansas, United States.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Opened in 1980, it comprises more than 100 stores in 951447 sqft of gross leasable area.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The mall's five anchor stores include Convergys, Dick's Sporting Goods, two Dillard's locations and JCPenney.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" Sears (the sixth anchor store) closed in December 2014, leaving one anchor space vacant.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The original anchor stores in the mall were: Dillard's, Henry's, JC Penney, Montgomery Ward and Service Merchandise.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" Sears opened in 1994 (14 years after the rest of the mall) moving a store from the open air Twin Lakes Shopping Center.","title":"Towne West Square"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" There is a drop in daycare closest to JCPenny that opened in May 2015 called the Kiddie Klubhouse.","title":"Towne West Square"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"What anchor store in the Stratford Square Mall has 728 department store locations in the continental United States?"}
